qa_pairs.question: What size screws are used for the stud in centrifugal governor?
What is the torque specification for the hexagon head screw on centrifugal governor?
Which transmission type uses the governor housing to hub specification?
How many different M6 screw applications are listed in the governor specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Three M6 screw applications are listed: stud in centrifugal governor, hexagon head screw on centrifugal governor, and governor housing to hub.
